name: DUMBBELL LEFT ARM TRICEPS KICKBACK
introduce:
Stand on your left leg with your right knee and right hand supporting on the bench. 

Hold a dumbbell in your left hand with your upper arm parallel to the floor. 

Kick your forearm back, then return and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Exhale as you kick your forearm back, and inhale as you return.
This exercise targets your triceps and helps sculpt your arms.
